VERDICT: LGTM

The change mirrors the established `AUDIT` logger pattern already present in this class: a `static final` named logger declared alongside `AUDIT` (line 70/73), and a parameterized `.info(...)` call placed inline in `addOwner` immediately after the existing audit emissions (line 160-161). The `id={} memberId={}` message format matches the phrasing of the adjacent `AUDIT.info` line, so a maintainer reading this file would find the addition natural and consistent.

- Logic is in the right unit: the controller already owns the inline cross-cutting log emissions for owner creation (audit + idempotency bookkeeping), so co-locating the notification emit there is coherent rather than introducing a new seam.
- Nothing is duplicated — it reuses the same `owner.getId()` / `owner.getMemberId()` accessors and slf4j idiom already in use.
- The `addOwner` method is not becoming a catch-all as a result of this two-line, single-responsibility addition; it stays within the existing pattern for post-create side effects.
- The Javadoc on the `NOTIFY` field matches the documentation style of the neighboring `AUDIT_SEQ` field.
